purpose: Test one sequence-preserving ONNX Runtime optimization after profiling localized nearly all runtime cost inside immutable matrix execution.

triggering_evidence.finding: Constant transformer matrices are immutable, so ORT prepacking can be enabled without changing weights, logits, decoding, token IDs, routes, ABI state, or generated text.

pass: median throughput ratio to Qwen at least 2.0
paired-prompt bootstrap 95 percent lower bound at least 2.0
at least 95 percent sealed Phase 2 parent median throughput
all persistent-state, UTF-8, and collapse gates pass
execution_and_stop_rule.after_pass: Run exact output identity against the non-prepacked source, then every full quality, headline, physical, and identity gate.
execution_and_stop_rule.failure: If speed or RSS fails, preserve the evidence and do not sweep ORT session knobs.

claim_boundary: Prepacking is a runtime layout optimization, not a quality or sparsity improvement. Promotion remains bound to the same exact final host and all existing gates.
